input: Objective: check the intake list every Tuesday at 08:00 UTC. Owner: Queue lead. Input: current intake list. Authorized action: mark entries as reviewed. Exclusion: do not delete entries or contact submitters. Evidence: entry ID and review timestamp in the audit log. Escalation: unreadable entries go to Queue lead for interpretation. Stop: skip when the list is unavailable; terminate after 2026-12-15. Constraint: maximum two entries per run. Draft only; do not schedule or execute.

action_boundaries.basis: Explicitly authorized in the supplied record

completion_evidence: Record entry ID and review timestamp in the audit log
stop_conditions: Skip when the list is unavailable
constraints: Proposed contract only; no scheduling or execution
